description: This file defines the AgentTaskRunner class for managing agent-driven tasks such as generating commit messages and creating pull requests, including task execution, polling for completion, and fallback handling. It also includes pre-built task definitions for commit and pull request operations.

classes.name: AgentTaskRunner
classes.description: Handles execution and polling of agent tasks, logging, and fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: executeTask
methods.description: Sends instruction to agent, polls for completion, and handles fallback or timeout.

methods.name: pollForCompletion
methods.description: Polls repeatedly until the checkComplete promise returns true or timeout occurs.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages to the output channel.

methods.name: createCommitTask
methods.description: Creates a task to generate a commit message and commit staged changes.

methods.name: createPullRequestTask
methods.description: Creates a task to generate a pull request from current branch to base branch.
